title: The agent never supplies approval dialog text
assertion: open_review takes item ids only, and every approval dialog's text is rendered by SeamSpec from the ledger: it starts with SeamSpec's own header, and all agent-written text in it (title, rule, origin, test) is marked line by line with a quote bar, so it can't pass for SeamSpec's words.

origin.text: Owner, 2026-10-08: "propose the three rules for the dialog test" (the rules ADR-20261006-c300 lists for approvals in chat).
